name: The Apartment Notice
description: A handwritten note from the quarantined town.
readingText:
To the residents of Stairwell B

Whoever keeps knocking on the third-floor doors after midnight, please stop.

I know it isn't the children. The children were evacuated last Tuesday.

Last night, something knocked on my door and spoke in my husband's voice. My husband has been in the hospital for eleven days.

I have pushed the wardrobe against the entrance.

If anyone from the housing office reads this, please send someone before dark.
